channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Binance says 90% of $6.3 billion hack losses are now covered, plans to resume withdrawals Sunday
item.description: Binance says it has restored backing for 90% of assets affected by its $6.3 billion hack and is planning to resume withdrawals, subject to security checks.

item.title: Trump promised to slash energy costs — but gasoline, diesel and jet fuel all soared instead
item.description: President Donald Trump promised voters who were angry about inflation that he would slash gasoline prices below $2 a gallon in his first year in office.

item.title: ‘Pop-up’ super PACs pour $637 million into 2026 midterm races
item.description: Twenty-two late-forming super PACs spent about $637 million in 2026 congressional races, sometimes before voters could see their donors.

item.title: Automakers like Rivian and Ford are ‘democratizing 3D printing’ to reduce costs and increase speed
item.description: Automakers including Ford, Rivian and GM are expanding 3D printing to make prototypes, factory tools and low-volume parts faster and at lower cost.

item.title: SpaceX loses bid to toss NAACP lawsuit over Memphis data center air pollution
item.description: The Colossus data centers and a power plant that SpaceXAI is also building in Southaven, Mississippi, have faced community backlash for years.

item.title: Intel stock plunges 29%. Analysts urge caution on buying the dip
item.description: Intel's sell-off could be a chance to buy the dip, but you need a long investing horizon.

item.title: Anthropic's path to the Nasdaq just got a lot bumpier
item.description: Concerning projections from hyperscalers this week punished tech stocks and pushed the Nasdaq to its first three-week losing streak since March.

item.title: Qatari mediators held talks in Tehran aimed at restarting direct U.S.-Iran negotiations, source says
item.description: Axios reported that Qatari mediators held more than 12 hours of talks in Tehran on Friday to reach a deal to avoid a resumption of American-led attacks on Iran.

item.title: G20 foreign ministers end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues
item.description: The group did not release a joint communique but will rather rely on a chairman's statement, which U.S Secretary of State Rubio said he would release Saturday.

item.title: Trump called out Big Oil profits. Here’s how much their refining earnings have surged since
item.description: Trump criticized Big Oil for making “too much money,” but oil majors have since reported surging refining earnings as fuel supplies tightened.

item.title: Halloween gets pricier as chocolate costs climb — Hershey may feel the pinch
item.description: Higher cocoa and sugar prices are fueling above-average cost inflation for candy

item.title: The rise of the 15-foot skeleton—how a viral novelty became a Halloween staple
item.description: In just six years, giant skeletons have gone from an absurd viral novelty to the centerpiece of an expanding retail arms race for the front lawn.

item.title: OpenAI slashes funding target by $10 billion amid tech rout, FT reports
item.description: Sam Altman's OpenAI is seeking about $20 billion with a desired valuation of $1.25 trillion, down from $1.4 billion, FT reported, citing people familiar.

item.title: Humans are still doing the work behind some AI agents
item.description: AI agents from startups including Dazzle, Duckbill and Wajo still rely on human workers for calls and other real-world tasks when software falls short.

item.title: Bank of America says buy these stocks ahead of earnings before it's too late
item.description: The firm named a slew of undervalued stocks to buy ahead of quarterly reports.

item.title: Gamble on democracy: Inside suspicious election-contracts trading on prediction markets
item.description: CNBC examines unusual price spikes in election prediction markets and how low-volume contracts can be moved by relatively small trades.

item.title: Berkshire ekes out some new highs, but October rally stalls
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway shares managed to set a few more all-time highs in an otherwise lackluster week of trading.

item.title: Automatic 401(k) rollovers reduce cash-outs, research finds — but few accounts reach new employer plans
item.description: Workers with small 401(k) balances are cashing out less often under an automatic portability program, but most accounts remain in temporary IRAs.

item.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns
item.description: Meta has been given a negative outlook by S&P Global Ratings due to the company's hefty capital expenditures and concerns about free cash flow.

item.title: Stocks started the week with promise but ended in despair. Our take on the big reversal
item.description: Big Tech earnings reignited AI spending fears, sending investors into defensive stocks.

item.title: The best high-yield savings accounts of November 2026: Earn up to 5.0%
item.description: Earn the most interest with our top-rated high-yield savings accounts.

item.title: Treasury Department announces new Series I bond rate of 5.51% for the next six months
item.description: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has announced new Series I bond rates through April 2027.

item.title: Binance, crypto and hacks: What to know about keeping coin safe as cyber criminals advance
item.description: The Binance hack of $6.3 billion, the largest crypto theft ever, is a wake-up call for investors to understand how coin is guarded and the risk of losing it.

item.title: In the wake of Weil, a legal recruiter's advice for surviving a company wind-down
item.description: Legal recruiter Danielle Thompson shares her best advice for the employees of Weil, Gotshal & Manges and others who face a company wind-down or dissolution.

item.title: How to start an art collection on any budget
item.description: A guide to beginning an art collection, including how to research artists, what to buy, and where to connect, from galleries to fairs to auction houses.

item.title: Alaska Senate election: DOJ wants to 'segregate' all ballots for 2nd Sullivan candidate
item.description: The winner of the Alaska election could determine whether Republicans retain their majority in the U.S. Senate or if Democrats take control of the chamber.

item.title: 35-year-old took on $20K in debt to launch a business from her dining room—now it brings in 8 figures a year
item.description: Set Active founder Lindsey Carter shares how she learned to separate her professional stress from her personal life while growing her athleisure company.

item.title: Stock market rocked as investors dump tech shares; Nasdaq suffers worst day since June: Live updates
item.description: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite posted its worst month since March 2025.

item.title: Intel stock has worst day since 1970s, wiping about $12 billion off government's stake
item.description: Investors are nervous about the massive AI spending from the tech giants and whether that will pay off.

item.title: Hong Kong telecom company agrees to halt U.S. operations under pressure
item.description: The FCC in October 2025 said it was moving to revoke the authority of HKT to operate in the United States, citing national security concerns.
